description: AS 4788 leaked routes from its provider AS 3549 to its peer AS 1257, violating the valley-free routing principle. The original path 3549 1239 1257 8437 39393 (peer-to-customer relationship) was replaced with 3549 4788 1257 8437 39393 where AS 4788 (a customer of AS 3549) improperly announced provider routes to its peer AS 1257.
